verdict: Retain provisional minor/true, narrowly as a universal procedural obligation assertion.
actual_read_extent: All thirteen author pages of SG2610210010, including surrounding qualified forecast criticism and alternative-allowance request.

Official unrestricted-taxpayer ELSTER 2025 title and complete Anlage N introduction, three cumulative exception conditions and nearby wage-entry explanation, independently opened through web reader and saved original HTML.
Exact BT 21/8235 operative physical page 7 and memorandum physical pages 26 and 28; no full bill read.
adversarial_checks: The official help overview generically lists Anlage N for employees, but its dedicated instructions expressly remove the attachment obligation under specified cumulative conditions. The more specific exception controls this comparison.

Compulsory assessment does not alone imply an entry in any of the listed extra lines. Ordinary electronically supplied wages for III/V spouses with below-allowance expenses can meet the exception. The author explicitly uses all compulsory cases rather than only complicated cases.
Adviser review and automatic or prefilled software transmission may still involve practical work. Those workflow concerns do not establish a universal legal obligation to submit the attachment.

2025 guidance retrieved live on 25 October is not an authenticated 21 October snapshot or final 2027 form. Preserve this temporal qualification. The exact proposed allowance amendment contains no identified removal of the exception.
The government’s 1.3 million estimate and five-minute saving remain unvalidated forecasts. Do not derive their truth from disproving the categorical objection.
severity_and_direction: Minor because this is one procedural premise alongside separate simplification and fairness arguments. True direction narrowly because the assertion understates the existing proposal’s possible simplification and supports priority for the alternative allowance.
